[Source](../../../../src/planet/osm-snapshot.ts)

Offline Z15 OSM snapshot (`osm.snapshot` / `osm-*.json.gz`).
Format `nabla-ways-osm-cell/1`: Overpass answers for features, buildings, roads.
Pure data: no DOM, no network.
